newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse to change trading time.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse to change trading time.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius (SEM) said on Tuesday it would increase trading time to two hours from one currently.
It said in a statement that trading sessions would start one hour earlier as from January 6 at 1000 (0600 GMT) from the present 1100 hours.
"This modification in trading coincides with the implementation of the Central Depository System (CDS) which will be effective as from mid-January 1997," the statement said.
The electronic share settlement CDS is expected to boost trading at the bourse and also provide a further incentive to attract foreign investors, SEM officials said.
